messages: Alex: quick morning handoff — I'm taking primary for the next 8h. short recap: two pages overnight, both mitigated. IncidentBot: [pager] INCIDENT #4731 embeddings-503 spike -> paging primary (Alex) at 03:14 UTC. IncidentBot: [pager] INCIDENT #4732 routing-spill-eu -> paging primary (Alex) at 04:01 UTC. Alex: Details: #4731 caused by redis eviction cascade on embed-cache; p95 token latency up, ~18% 503s for ~12m. We replayed warm prefixes and raised replica count, p95 recovered. mitigation steps in runbook. Sam: added observability note — spike correlated with scheduled batch job that mis-labeled keys. I pushed a hotfix to batch job to add a short jitter and key prefix. Maria: confirmation — embedding SLOs back to normal, customer-facing errors limited to a handful of requests, no broad degradation. Priya: I'm on secondary; I'll take follow-up ownership for post-mortem and add a minimal regression test for the batch. Alex: #4732 routing-spill-eu — a BGP flap + in-flight connection resets caused partial regional routing mismatch -> some requests hit overloaded nodes, leading to 502/503 cascade. we switched fallback routing to region-us and drained the affected pool. full traffic normalized within ~9m. Sam: left snippets in ops channel with commands used: `kubectl cordon embed-node-48 && ./drain-pool --pool=eu-embed --grace=30s` and `curl -X POST https://router.internal/reload-config`. Maria: I've uploaded logs and a short list of affected customers to the secure ops bucket: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/4731-4732/ — follow the ACL for access. Alex: current status: both incidents resolved, alerts suppressed, still seeing a smattering of late-req traces (~1 every 10m) but causes look like retries and client-side timeouts. Next steps: Priya to run the PM template and assign retros; Sam to add the batch jitter and a feature flag; Maria to trigger a capacity test for eu-embed pool. Priya: will do PM and schedule a postmortem meeting for tomorrow 14:00 UTC. I'll own action tracking. Sam: I'll open the PR for the batch jitter in the next 2h and link to the runbook. Maria: I'll kick off a targeted capacity soak and share results in this thread. Alex: runbooks and links -> embeddings runbook: https://runbooks.internal/embeddings-cache; routing runbook: https://runbooks.internal/routing-fallbacks; on-call play: https://confluence.internal/oncall/playbook. Also note: temp mitigation we used (`drain-pool`) is in playbook step 4, not 3 — added a comment to clarify. IncidentBot: alert suppression lifted at 05:10 UTC. Priya: handover acceptance — thanks Alex, taking secondary -> primary at 11:00 UTC local if needed. Alex: handed off state: dashboards stable, no open pages, primary pager is with Priya at 11:00 if escalation needed, pager duty rotation updated. closing note: if you see recurring redis evictions, escalate to eng-infra and xref incident #4731. Sam: ack. Maria: ack. Alex: signing off for now, reachable on pager until handoff. :thumbsup:
